tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: The desktop base, and the background terminal's background. The lowest layer of the screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels floating over the terminal: the sidebar, widgets, window bodies.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: See-through panels that let the terminal text show faintly; use with a backdrop-filter blur.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, panel borders, dividers. For separation only, never for text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text and terminal output, on desk and surface (contrast > 13:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, paths, help text, on desk and surface (contrast ≈ 6:1).

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Brand color: the prompt, the cursor, success, and "this terminal has the keyboard".

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus rings, selection, the active window's border. Differs from phosphor in both lightness and hue.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings, long-running processes, notices that need attention.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error output and failures. Only for errors, never decoration.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its text; inset of the terminal's character grid.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items inside a panel and between sidebar buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Safe distance from the terminal to the screen edge, and for floating panels.
